title: FHGM draft transport overlay for FHGFF3 1.1 and 1.2 headers (proposal)
description: Transport-only overlay for native FHGM draft contract v0.1. It admits either released FHGFF3 file identity a carrier can cite today - the v0.5.0 identity with schemaVersion 1.1, or the v0.6.0 identity with schemaVersion 1.2 - each as a closed branch pairing that schema URI set with that schemaVersion, so a citation and a stated version that contradict each other are rejected. Maintainer decision of 2026-11-15: FHGM carriers must be describable on both released bases, because the released toolkit writes 1.2 headers today while the sealed v0.1 fixtures and vectors carry 1.1 bytes; the choice never falls back to a single pin. FORMAT.md R15 permits x- keys from schemaVersion 1.1, so 1.0 stays inadmissible and the base schema itself rejects it. It intentionally does not describe record contents: each record validates against fhgm-model.schema.json in the separate model-level checker (validate_fhgm.py), which also resolves which registered FHGFF3 base release (development/model/base-schemas.json) validates the carrier and prints that selection. The base FHGFF3 schema validates transport only; model-level meaning is never established by the base schema, and the file checksum covers every embedded record byte like any other header byte.
